curriculum_video_overview.video_title: Curiosity Class 6 Science - Full Curriculum Overview
curriculum_video_overview.topics_covered: Comprehensive overview of the Class 6 Science Curiosity textbook, introducing experiential inquiry, interdisciplinary scientific methods, biodiversity, nutrition, magnetism, measurement, materials, water cycle, separation techniques, biological characteristics, natural resources, and celestial astronomy.

image_asset.title: Scientific Method Flowchart & Bicycle Puncture Leak Test

hotspots.label: Observation & Wondering
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Noticing everyday curiosities like dal spilling out of a pressure cooker or a flat bicycle tire.

hotspots.label: Asking Questions
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Formulating precise whys and hows to define the scientific problem being investigated.

hotspots.label: Formulating Hypothesis
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Proposing a testable educated guess or explanation based on initial observations.

hotspots.label: Controlled Experimentation
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Testing hypotheses systematically, such as submerging an inflated bike tube in water to observe escaping bubbles.

hotspots.label: Data Analysis & Conclusion
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Analyzing experimental findings to confirm or revise the original hypothesis.

video_overview.title: The Wonderful World of Science
video_overview.topics_covered: Introduction to curiosity, the 5-step scientific method (observation, question, hypothesis, experiment, conclusion), bicycle tube puncture leak test, and everyday problem solving.

image_asset.title: Plant Taxonomy Growth Habits & Animal Locomotion Adaptations

hotspots.label: Herbs, Shrubs & Trees
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Classifying plants by stem rigidity, height, and branching patterns into herbs, shrubs, and trees.

hotspots.label: Climbers & Creepers
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Identifying weak-stemmed plants that spread on ground (creepers) or climb using support structures (climbers).

hotspots.label: Venation & Root Correlation
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Linking reticulate leaf venation with taproots and parallel leaf venation with fibrous root systems.

hotspots.label: Aquatic Adaptations
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Examining streamlined body shapes in fish and webbed feet in ducks that minimize water resistance.

hotspots.label: Mountain & Desert Survival
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Analyzing Deodar conical snow-shedding structures and cactus spine adaptations for transpiration control.

video_overview.title: Decoding the Living World
video_overview.topics_covered: Biodiversity exploration, plant growth habits (herbs, shrubs, trees, climbers, creepers), venation patterns, and structural adaptations in aquatic and terrestrial animals.

media_catalog.chapter_title: Mindful Eating: A Path to a Healthy Body

image_asset.title: 7 Essential Nutrient Classes & Traditional Millet Superfood Wheel

hotspots.label: Energy-Giving Nutrients
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Carbohydrates and fats providing instant and stored metabolic energy for daily activity.

hotspots.label: Body-Building Proteins
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Proteins facilitating tissue growth, cellular repair, and muscle development.

hotspots.label: Protective Vitamins & Minerals
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Micro-nutrients defending against deficiency diseases (scurvy, beriberi, anemia, rickets).

hotspots.label: Chemical Nutrient Testing
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Detecting starch with Iodine solution, proteins with CuSO4 + NaOH (violet color), and fats via paper translucency.

hotspots.label: Native Millet Superfoods
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Drought-resilient grains like Jowar, Bajra, and Ragi rich in minerals and dietary fiber.

video_overview.title: Mindful Eating
video_overview.topics_covered: 7 nutrient classes (carbohydrates, fats, proteins, vitamins, minerals, roughage, water), chemical tests for starch/fats/proteins, traditional food philosophy, and millets.

image_asset.title: Bar Magnet Field Lines, Pole Concentration & Compass Directive Property

hotspots.label: Magnetic vs Non-Magnetic
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Differentiating ferromagnetic substances (iron, nickel, cobalt) from non-magnetic wood or plastic.

hotspots.label: Pole Force Concentration
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Demonstrating maximum iron filing attraction at the North (N) and South (S) magnetic poles.

hotspots.label: Directive Property & Compass
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Freely suspended magnets aligning along Earth’s Geographic North-South axis.

hotspots.label: Single-Touch Magnetization
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Stroking an iron strip with a magnet pole repeatedly in one direction to align internal domains.

hotspots.label: Repulsion Test & Keeper Storage
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Proving repulsion is the only sure test for magnetism; storing magnets paired with soft iron keepers.

video_overview.title: Solving with Magnetism
video_overview.topics_covered: Magnetic vs non-magnetic materials, pole concentration, freely suspended directional alignment, Matsya-yantra compass history, single-touch magnetization, and magnet safety.

image_asset.title: Metric SI Scale Alignment, Parallax Error Prevention & Motion Types

hotspots.label: Standard SI Unit Metre
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Replacing variable body measurements (handspan, cubit) with standard metric SI units (m, cm, mm, km).

hotspots.label: Parallax Error Elimination
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Positioning the eye directly vertically above the scale reading mark to prevent measurement inaccuracy.

hotspots.label: Broken Zero Scale Offset
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Measuring from a clear integer mark (e.g. 1.0 cm) and subtracting it from the final reading.

hotspots.label: Curved Boundary Thread Loop
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Tracing curved perimeters using a flexible thread and measuring the straightened thread on a ruler.

hotspots.label: Motion Classification Types
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Categorizing motion into Rectilinear (straight line), Circular (curved path), Periodic (equal time intervals), and Multiple combinations.

video_overview.title: Measurement & Motion
video_overview.topics_covered: Transition from handspan/cubit to SI unit metre, precision scale rules, avoiding parallax error, measuring curved lines with thread, and motion types.

image_asset.title: Physical Properties Matrix: Mass, Volume, Hardness, Solubility & Transparency

hotspots.label: Matter Mass & Volume
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Defining matter as anything that possesses mass and occupies physical space or volume.

hotspots.label: Lustre & Surface Hardness
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Testing metallic shine (lustre) and scratch resistance (hardness vs softness).

hotspots.label: Aqueous Solubility & Miscibility
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Differentiating soluble/insoluble solids and miscible liquids (lemon juice) from immiscible liquids (oil).

hotspots.label: Transparency Spectrum
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Categorizing objects into Transparent (clear view), Translucent (partial view), and Opaque (no light pass).

hotspots.label: Density & Flotation Sorting
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Observing floating low-density materials (dry leaf, wood) versus sinking high-density materials (iron nail, stone).

video_overview.title: Materials Around Us
video_overview.topics_covered: Grouping materials by physical properties (lustre, hardness, solubility, miscible/immiscible liquids, transparency), matter definition, and historical metallurgy.

image_asset.title: Clinical Thermometer Capillary Kink Mechanism & Temperature Scales

hotspots.label: Unreliability of Touch
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Demonstrating that hand touch sensation is relative and unreliable using the 3-beaker water experiment.

hotspots.label: Clinical Thermometer Kink
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Capillary constriction (kink) preventing mercury column backflow when removed from human body.

hotspots.label: Laboratory Thermometer Rules
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Reading temperature while the glass bulb remains fully immersed upright in the test liquid.

hotspots.label: Temperature Scale Conversion
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Converting Celsius (°C) to Fahrenheit (°F) using F = (9/5)*C + 32, and Kelvin (K) = C + 273.15.

hotspots.label: Max-Min Weather Tracking
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Recording daily atmospheric extreme temperatures using specialized Maximum-Minimum thermometers.

video_overview.title: The Science of Temperature
video_overview.topics_covered: Limits of touch sensation, defining temperature, Celsius/Fahrenheit/Kelvin scales, clinical kink mechanics, laboratory thermometers, and meteorologist Anna Mani.

media_catalog.chapter_title: A Journey through States of Water

image_asset.title: Three Physical States Phase Transformations, Evaporation & Water Cycle

hotspots.label: Solid-Liquid-Gas Phases
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Reversible phase changes of water between solid ice, liquid water, and gaseous water vapor.

hotspots.label: Evaporation Dynamics
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Surface evaporation rate increasing with higher temperature, larger exposed surface area, wind speed, and low humidity.

hotspots.label: Atmospheric Condensation
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Water vapor cooling on microscopic dust condensation nuclei in air to form cloud droplets.

hotspots.label: Global Hydrological Cycle
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Continuous circulation of water between Earth oceans, atmosphere, soil, and ground aquifers.

hotspots.label: Traditional Bawadis & AWGs
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Heritage rainwater stepwells (Toorji ka Jhalra) and modern Atmospheric Water Generators harvesting airborne moisture.

video_overview.title: Investigating Water
video_overview.topics_covered: 3 states of water (ice, liquid, vapor), phase changes, factors affecting evaporation rate, atmospheric condensation, hydrological cycle, Bawadis stepwells, and AWGs.

media_catalog.chapter_title: Methods of Separation in Everyday Life

image_asset.title: Separation Method Flowchart: Sieving, Filtration, Decantation & Evaporation

hotspots.label: Dry Grain Processing
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Extracting clean grain using handpicking, stalks threshing, wind winnowing, and particle-size sieving.

hotspots.label: Sedimentation & Decantation
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Allowing heavy insoluble solids to settle at the bottom (sedimentation) and pouring off clear liquid (decantation).

hotspots.label: Filter Cone Separation
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Passing a liquid mixture through porous filter paper to collect solid residue while liquid filtrate passes through.

hotspots.label: Solar Salt Evaporation
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Heating saline seawater in shallow coastal pans to evaporate liquid water and harvest pure sea salt.

hotspots.label: Multi-Step Scheme Isolation
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Combining magnetic extraction, winnowing, dissolution, filtration, and evaporation to separate complex 4-component mixtures.

video_overview.title: Science of Separation
video_overview.topics_covered: Handpicking, threshing, winnowing, sieving, sedimentation, decantation, filtration (filtrate vs residue), solar salt evaporation, curd churning, and magnetic separation.

image_asset.title: 7 Universal Traits of Life, Mimosa pudica Thigmonasty & Germination Stages

hotspots.label: 7 Biological Life Traits
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: 7 universal characteristics: nutrition, growth, cellular respiration, excretion, response to stimuli, reproduction, movement.

hotspots.label: Living Organism vs Motor Car
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Proving moving non-living objects (cars, clouds) lack internal respiration, growth, cell structure, and reproduction.

hotspots.label: Sensory Stimuli & Tropisms
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Observing Mimosa pudica rapid leaf drooping (thigmonasty) and plant shoot growth toward light (phototropism).

hotspots.label: Seed Dormancy & Germination
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Activating latent seed life processes when provided with air, water moisture, and suitable temperature.

hotspots.label: Respiration vs Breathing
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Distinguishing mechanical gas exchange (breathing) from cellular metabolic energy breakdown of food (respiration).

video_overview.title: What Makes Something Alive?
video_overview.topics_covered: 7 universal biological traits, motor car vs living entity comparison, Mimosa pudica leaf folding, seed dormancy activation, respiration vs breathing, and plant tropisms.

image_asset.title: Natural Resource Classification, Forest Humus Cycle & Root Soil Binding

hotspots.label: Natural Treasures
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Essential earth gifts: air composition (78% N2, 21% O2), pure water, sunlight, fertile soil, and forests.

hotspots.label: Microbial Humus Formation
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Soil microbes decomposing fallen organic leaf litter into nutrient-rich black humus layer.

hotspots.label: Root Soil Erosion Control
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Deep plant root networks anchoring soil particles to prevent rainwater erosion and landslides.

hotspots.label: Harvest Ethics & Sustainability
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Traditional Western Ghats Nellikai (Amla) ground collection practices that preserve wild trees and forest wildlife.

hotspots.label: Renewable Solar & Wind Energy
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Harnessing inexhaustible solar photovoltaic cells and wind turbines to replace depleting fossil fuels.

video_overview.title: Nature's Treasures
video_overview.topics_covered: Natural resources (air, water, soil, sunlight, forests), atmospheric composition, leaf litter microbial humus formation, root erosion prevention, Nellikai harvest ethics, and 3Rs.

image_asset.title: 8-Planet Solar System Sequence, Venus Heat Trap & Saptarishi Constellation

hotspots.label: Stars vs Reflective Planets
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Distinguishing nuclear-glowing self-luminous stars from planets and moons reflecting sunlight.

hotspots.label: 8-Planet Solar Sequence
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Solar system planetary order: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.

hotspots.label: Venus CO2 Greenhouse Trap
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Dense carbon dioxide atmosphere making Venus (464°C) hotter than innermost Mercury.

hotspots.label: Saptarishi Pole Star Navigation
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Aligning Saptarishi (Big Dipper) pointer stars to locate Dhruva Tara (Pole Star) pointing Geographic North.

hotspots.label: Hanle Dark Sky Reserve
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: High-altitude astronomical observatory in Ladakh minimizing urban light pollution for celestial stargazing.

video_overview.title: Beyond Earth
video_overview.topics_covered: Self-luminous stars vs reflective planets, 8-planet sequence, Venus CO2 runaway greenhouse heat trap, Pluto dwarf planet criteria, Saptarishi/Big Dipper navigation, and Hanle reserve.
